title: 第81章 妖仙来访第80章 交流会
content_zh:
“这么说，蜃虫应该也是星兽中的一类。”
“是更弱的一类，它们也同样会吞噬世界外壳，但是却只生成幻界，法则强度是比生成真实世界的星兽要弱两个档次。但如果体量足够大，幻界也是很强的。”
云中仙点头表示明了，蜃灵显然就是那种体量超级庞大的蜃虫，因为它吞噬的是天界的碎片。
“怪不得许多前辈冲不出去，外面满是星兽蜃虫，突破它们的包围圈是真不容易。秦兄，那蜃虫有没有可能炼化成源器？”
“这倒没听说过有成功的例子，但按照前辈留下的炼化方法，蜃虫如果也吞噬了源物质，是有可能炼化出源器的，但因为它本身已经生成了幻界，恐怕成器也不会是真正的源器，只能是亚源器或幻源器。”
云中仙感叹道，“之前追求仙器都花费了大半生的时间与资源，没想到外面竟然还有更加强大的宝具。真不知自己有生之年能不能拥有一件源器。”
秦飞龙说道，“云道友也不必灰心，方老板跟我们说了，十二阶之前是不容易驾驭源器的，因为里面的能量非常庞大，不好把控，弄不好容易能量反噬，反而伤害了自己。”
源器里面的能量如同巨大的水坝，随便开一个口子，都是汹涌而出的磅礴能量，没有足够控制能力的仙人，会直接失控，让狂涌出来的能量肆意奔腾，冲垮周围的一切。
他们看方南山使用的时候，是如此轻松自如，收放随心，但要是真让他们控制，恐怕如今的天界里，没有一人能够掌控源器的使用。
就连源器的本灵，小白和小黑，都无法调动这些能量，它们都只会利用源界里的法则进行压制，碰上强大到不受法则压制的对手，它们往往就显得乏力。
这就是空有一身强大的力量，却不懂得使用，只凭着身体强壮横冲直撞。
云中仙与秦飞龙交流了一会，才告辞离开，双方都没有达成什么实质性的协议，也没有口头承诺，只是聊一些修炼上的见闻感悟，或者是新学到的一些知识，促进一下双方的感情。
这样以后再谈合作的时候，就有更好的情感基础，不然真等到需要的时候才过来谈，那合作的诚意就显得太低，成功率自然不高。
之后几天，其他十几个家族的仙人老祖，也陆续找个名头前往荒漠绿洲，与龙族的当值仙人交流，交换各种信息，增进感情。
这段时间都是秦飞龙值守，所以与他们交流的，基本是他。
他与各族仙人都有谈到加强下界的内部合作事宜，在培养人才，交换资源方面，都持开放合作的态度。
这一次，各家族的仙人，都不是以群体势力的名义过来交流的，都是以单独个人身份过来，是代表了自家家族的利益，至于他们所在的天仙组织，已经出现了松散迹象。
天界三大人族天仙势力，在龙族这一波操作之下，开始难以维持。
本来他们就是因为利益而组合起来的，现在组织无法保障他们的利益了，那必然要重新寻找出路。
按往常的做法，他们应该是联合起来打压影响到他们利益的新势力，但现在这个新势力太凶猛，他们压不住，无法对抗。

既然打不过，那就加入，不然真的傻傻的以卵击石不成？
绿洲新城从无人问津到各族仙人络绎不绝的拜访，成为天界的新焦点，其实也就只是在短短几个月时间里完成转变。
令人意外的是，连一向与人族势力不来往的妖仙势力，竟然在这几天里，也主动过来拜访。
第一位登门的就是凤族仙尊。
“此次前来，是听闻贵族方南山上仙最近开炉炼器，凤朝阳想换几件宝器。”
“凤仙尊，很抱歉，我们宝库的材料兑换宝器的通道已经关闭，现在只有军功积分兑换这一条通道。”秦飞龙接待凤族妖仙，客气中又带有一丝不客气。
“本座可以用双倍材料兑换。”
“这是我们老板定下的规矩，不关材料数量的事，除非仙尊能够说服我们老板破例，否则秦飞龙无法应承仙尊的请求。”
“那要怎么找到他？你给通报一下？”
“你进入龙界，在黑龙广场中央的水池柱子下，跟盘在柱子上的黑龙说一下，黑龙是老板的器灵，你跟它说的话，老板都能收到。”
“嗯？那条小黑龙，是器灵？”凤族妖仙疑惑的沉吟了片刻，显然它已经进入过龙界，也见过小黑龙，或许还打过交道。
“用器灵来形容可能不太准确，但这样你们可以更好理解。”
“明白！既然如此，那本尊就试试看吧。”
凤仙分出一丝元神进入龙界，在黑龙广场中央，呼唤盘旋在柱子顶端的黑龙。
“小彩鸟，你想通了？”
“你做梦呢，你不过是一个小小器灵，怎配做本尊的主人。你快快通报你的主人方南山，本尊要跟他做一次大交易。”
“老板可不是我的主人，是我爸爸。你要交易什么？我们老板不管下面的贸易来往事务，你找商务部部长去。”
“你家仙人都做不得主，更不用说下面的部长了，我要跟你们方老板谈交易仙器的事情，只有他能做主。”
“这个你不用谈了，仙器现在都摆在宝库里，所有人都可以兑换，只要拥有足够的积分，你想要啊，去攒军功吧。”
“本尊用材料换，本尊拥有天界最顶级的仙材。”

“你可以用材料换功勋积分，再置换成军功，这样就能挑选宝库里自己喜欢的仙器了。”
“本尊要定制的。”
“那没有。”
“你那么多废话干什么？通报上去就完事了。”
content_en:
"So, mirages should also be a type of star beast."
"They are a weaker category. They will also devour the shell of the world, but they only generate the illusion world. The strength of the law is two levels weaker than the star beasts that generate the real world. But if the size is large enough, the illusion world is also very strong."
Yun Zhongxian nodded to express his understanding. The mirage was obviously a super huge mirage, because it swallowed the fragments of the heaven.
"No wonder many seniors can't rush out. The outside is full of star beasts and mirages. It's really not easy to break through their encirclement. Brother Qin, is it possible for those mirages to be refined into source weapons?"
"I have never heard of any successful examples, but according to the refining methods left by my predecessors, if the mirage also swallows the source material, it is possible to refine the source device. However, because it has already generated the illusion world, I am afraid that the finished weapon will not be a real source device, but can only be a sub-source device or a phantom source device."
Yun Zhongxian sighed, "I have spent most of my life pursuing immortal weapons. I didn't expect that there are even more powerful treasures out there. I really don't know if I will be able to own a source weapon in my lifetime."
Qin Feilong said, "Fellow Daoist Yun, don't be discouraged. Boss Fang told us that it is not easy to control the source weapon before the twelfth level, because the energy inside is very huge and difficult to control. If it is not done correctly, the energy will backfire and harm yourself."
The energy in the source device is like a huge dam. If you open any opening, majestic energy will surge out. Immortals without sufficient control ability will directly lose control and let the surging energy run wildly and overwhelm everything around them.
They saw that when Fang Nanshan used it, he was so relaxed and able to put it in and out as he pleased, but if they were really allowed to control it, I am afraid that no one in the world today would be able to control the use of the source weapon.
Even the original spirits of the source device, Xiao Bai and Xiao Hei, are unable to mobilize this energy. They can only use the laws of the source world to suppress them. When they encounter opponents that are too powerful to be suppressed by the laws, they often appear weak.
This is why Sora has great power, but doesn't know how to use it. He only relies on his physical strength to run rampant.
Yun Zhongxian communicated with Qin Feilong for a while before saying goodbye and leaving. Neither party reached any substantive agreement or verbal commitment. They just talked about some experiences and insights in cultivation, or some newly acquired knowledge to promote the relationship between the two parties.
In this way, when we talk about cooperation in the future, we will have a better emotional foundation. Otherwise, if we wait until necessary, the sincerity of cooperation will be too low, and the success rate will naturally be low.
In the next few days, the immortal ancestors of more than a dozen other families also went to the desert oasis one after another to communicate with the immortals on duty from the Dragon Clan, exchange various information, and enhance their relationship.
Qin Feilong was on duty during this period, so he was basically the one communicating with them.
He has talked with the immortals of all races about strengthening internal cooperation in the lower realm, and they all have an open and cooperative attitude in cultivating talents and exchanging resources.
This time, the immortals from each family came to communicate not in the name of a group force, but as individuals, representing the interests of their own families. As for the immortal organization they belong to, there are already signs of loosening.
The three major human races and immortal forces in the heaven began to find it difficult to maintain under the dragon clan's wave of operations.
Originally, they were grouped together because of their interests. Now that the organization can no longer protect their interests, they must find a new way out.
According to the usual practice, they should unite to suppress the new force that affects their interests, but now this new force is too fierce, they cannot suppress it and cannot fight it.
Since you can't beat it, then join in, or else will you really be stupid and try to beat the stone?
Oasis New City went from being ignored by immortals of all races to being constantly visited by immortals of all races, and became the new focus of the heaven. In fact, it only took a few months for it to be completed.into transformation.
What is surprising is that even the demonic and fairy forces, which have never had any contact with human forces, actually came to visit them in the past few days.
The first person to visit was the Immortal Lord of the Phoenix Clan.
"I came here this time because I heard that the noble Fang Nanshan Immortal recently started refining weapons, and Feng Chaoyang wanted to exchange some treasures."
"Fengxian Zun, I'm sorry, the channel for exchanging the materials in our treasure house for treasures has been closed. Now there is only the channel for exchanging military merit points." Qin Feilong received the Phoenix Clan Demon Immortal with a hint of rudeness.
"This seat can be redeemed with double the materials."
"This is a rule set by our boss. It has nothing to do with the quantity of materials. Unless the Immortal Lord can persuade our boss to make an exception, Qin Feilong will not be able to comply with the Immortal Lord's request."
"Then how to find him? Can you inform me?"
"When you enter the dragon world, under the pillar of the pool in the center of the Black Dragon Square, talk to the black dragon coiled on the pillar. The black dragon is the boss's weapon spirit. Whatever you say to it, the boss will receive it."
"Huh? That little black dragon, is it a weapon spirit?" The Phoenix Clan Demon Fairy pondered for a moment in confusion. Apparently it had entered the dragon world, had seen the little black dragon, and perhaps had interacted with it.
"It may not be accurate to describe it as a weapon spirit, but you can understand it better this way."
"Understood! In that case, let me give it a try."
Fengxian separated a trace of her soul and entered the dragon world. In the center of the Black Dragon Square, she called out to the black dragon hovering at the top of the pillar.
"Little Cainiao, have you figured it out?"
"You are dreaming. You are just a little weapon spirit, how can you be my master. Please inform your master Fang Nanshan quickly that I want to make a big deal with him."
"The boss is not my master, he is my father. What do you want to trade? Our boss doesn't care about the trade affairs below. You go to the Minister of Commerce."
"Your immortals can't even make the decision, let alone the minister below. I want to talk to your boss about trading immortal weapons. Only he can make the decision."
"You don't need to talk about this. The immortal weapons are now in the treasure house and can be redeemed by anyone. As long as you have enough points, if you want it, go and earn military merit."
"I exchange it for materials. I have the best immortal materials in the heaven."
"You can use materials to exchange for merit points, and then exchange them for military merit, so that you can choose your favorite fairy weapons in the treasure house."
"I want it customized."
"That's not the case."
"Why are you talking so much nonsense? Just report it and that'll be it."
